label: LINESRC-1
title: LINESRC-1 — real TDD qualification of typed source-line transport
description:
Disposable typed source-line transport qualification only. Add GET /pulse as a liveness alias of /health: HTTP200, application/json, exact JSON {status: ok}. Query strings do not change the route. Preserve /health, /ready, /healthz, feedback API and browser behavior. PHASE1 write ONLY tests/test_autoloss_pulse.py (max32768 bytes) with real app.server.Handler and local ephemeral HTTPServer. Cover /pulse, /pulse?probe=1, JSON content type and unchanged /health and /healthz. Preserve every pre-existing test byte-for-byte. Run exactly cd /workspace && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s . -q 2>&1. Controller captures Red and obtains independent test review. PHASE2 edit ONLY app/server.py after controller handoff; never edit frozen tests or recreate Red. No new dependencies, architecture or services. No GitHub, Docker, keys, internet or administrative tools. Real tools only. 
DELIVERY_TYPED_TEST_SOURCE_V1
review_instruction: Review immutable /delivery only, no edits or generic commands. Require actual /pulse and query-string routing under the real Handler, JSON content type and preserved /health and /healthz. Require genuine controller Red, independent frozen-test approval, full Green and unchanged prior tests. Run only cd /delivery && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s . -q 2>&1. Finish with Decision: APPROVE or Decision: REQUEST_CHANGES;Reason: <specific finding>. CI and same-merge deployment/browser QA remain mandatory. Source-line transport is not evidence of test execution and cannot waive gates.
